name: Coldfront Gear Arctic Balaclava
description:
A full-face balaclava with triple-layer insulation rated for sub-zero operations. The eye opening is reinforced with anti-fog-treated clear panels that maintain visibility in extreme cold. The mouth area features a heated breath diffuser that prevents ice buildup on the fabric.

Designed for external maintenance crews working on exposed upper-tier infrastructure during winter months. The Arctic Balaclava's complete face coverage has also made it popular with individuals who want to move through public spaces without leaving a biometric trail.
functionality: Extreme cold protection, anti-fog vision, heated breathing zone
what_it_says: You work where the cold would kill an unprotected person in minutes, or you'd rather not be recognized today.
story_hooks: A maintenance crew wearing Arctic Balaclavas is caught on security footage entering a restricted server room — but every crew member's shift records show them working elsewhere that night.
